title: Users need a way to archive objectives achieved, independently from preferences
body:
APS version 3.0

Users need a way to archive objectives achieved, independently to preferences.

As is now, restoring objectives can only be done by way of importing an old settings file.
Preferences from the old settings file are most likely outdated and will overwrite current settings.

comments.body:
Possible solution:
While importing give the user the option to import "Objectives only"?
80% of users would do this instead of pass them
everyone would look for any export on internet and just import finished preferences
